formulas.rho: intersecting cross-pairs of the two external-transversal families of an apartment
formulas.tau: outside common transversals of the three K1,3 leaf lines

same_parameter_obstruction: W33 and dual W33 both have order (3,3) but different (rho,sigma,tau) and different exact primitive-C8 apartment/star coefficients.
theorem: All six Pass4635 primitive-C8 raw masses have closed local formulas. Four depend only on s,t; apartment 1111|22 requires rho and sigma, and star 1113|2 requires tau. W33 and its dual prove that no (s,t)-only law exists.
boundary: Exact generalized-quadrangle local combinatorics. rho, sigma and tau are incidence invariants of the selected embedded support; they are not replaced by numerological functions of s,t.
